description: This file contains definitions and configurations for building firmware images for various devices based on the MT7621 SoC. It includes device-specific variables, build instructions, image sizes, package lists, and custom scripts for preparing firmware images, such as adding headers, signing, and metadata. The file is used to define how to compile and assemble firmware images for a range of hardware models, mostly in a router firmware project.
